iosInstallNow.title: iOS with Install on this device
iosInstallNow.body:
This method is available only on iPhone with iOS 17.4 or later.

After you buy a Etizaz eSIM, open **Installation**. If you left that screen, go to **My eSIMs**, open the order, and tap **Install eSIM**.

Stay connected to Wi-Fi until install finishes. An eSIM can be installed only once.

## For iPhone — Install on this device
- On Installation, tap **Install on this device**
- Tap **Allow** on the Activate New eSIM pop-up
- Tap **Continue** until Cellular Setup finishes
- Give the line a name so you can recognise it (for example Travel)
- Keep your primary line for calls and iMessage. Set the new eSIM as the line for **Cellular Data**
- Open the new eSIM, turn the line on, and turn **Data Roaming** on
- In Cellular Data, confirm the new eSIM is selected
- Follow **How to activate eSIM?** in the app if you still have no data

iosQr.title: iOS with QR code
iosQr.body:
After you buy a Etizaz eSIM, open **Installation**. If you left that screen, go to **My eSIMs**, open the order, and tap **Install eSIM**.

Stay connected to Wi-Fi until install finishes.

## For iPhone — QR code
- Open **Settings** > Cellular (or Mobile Data)
- Tap **Add eSIM**
- Tap **Use QR Code**
- Scan the QR code shown on Installation (use another device, or a screenshot)
- Tap **Continue** until setup finishes
- Name the line, then set the new eSIM for **Cellular Data**
- Turn the line on and turn **Data Roaming** on
- Confirm the new eSIM is selected for Cellular Data

androidQr.title: Android with QR code
androidQr.body:
After you buy a Etizaz eSIM, open **Installation**. If you left that screen, go to **My eSIMs**, open the order, and tap **Install eSIM**.

Stay connected to the internet until install finishes. An eSIM can be installed only once.

## For Android — QR code
- Share or screenshot the QR code so you can scan it with this phone
- Go to **Settings > Network & internet** (or Connections)
- Tap **Add** or **+** next to SIMs / Mobile network
- Scan the QR code from Installation and confirm
- Turn the new eSIM on
- Set it as preferred for mobile data
- Turn **Data roaming** on
- Follow **How to activate eSIM?** in the app if APN or roaming steps are required

manualIos.title: Manual installation on iOS
manualIos.body:
Use this if you cannot scan the QR code.

- Open the Etizaz app
- Go to **My eSIMs**, open the order, tap **Install eSIM**
- Open the **Manual** tab
- Copy the SM-DP+ address and activation code

Then in iPhone Settings:
- Cellular (or Mobile Data) > **Add eSIM**
- **Use QR Code** > **Enter Details Manually**
- Paste the SM-DP+ address and activation code
- Tap Next, then Continue
- Keep Primary for calls and iMessage / FaceTime
- Choose the new eSIM for Cellular Data > Continue > turn the line on
- Turn **Data Roaming** on

manualAndroid.title: Manual installation on Android
manualAndroid.body:
Use this if you cannot scan the QR code. Menu names vary by brand.

- Open the Etizaz app
- Go to **My eSIMs**, open the order, tap **Install eSIM**
- Open the **Manual** tab and copy the activation code (full LPA)

Then on the phone:
- Go to Settings > Connections > SIM Manager > Add eSIM (Samsung) or Settings > Network & internet > SIMs > Add (Pixel and others)
- Choose to enter the activation code instead of scanning
- Paste the code from Installation
- Tap Connect, then Add
- Set the new eSIM as preferred for mobile data
- Turn Data roaming on
- Follow **How to activate eSIM?** if you need to add an APN

whichNetwork.title: Which network should I connect to?
whichNetwork.body:
Most of the time the eSIM connects automatically to a supported network in your plan’s coverage area.

If you have no data, pick the network manually in your phone settings:
- **iPhone:** Settings > Cellular > your eSIM > Network Selection > turn off automatic and choose a network
- **Android:** Settings > Connections or Network & internet > Mobile networks > Network operators

Your coverage is the destination of the Etizaz plan you bought (shown on the order). There is no separate supported-networks screen in the app.

whenPlanStarts.title: When does the data plan start?
whenPlanStarts.body:
For Etizaz eSIMs, the validity period usually starts when the eSIM is installed and connects to a supported network.

- If the plan starts on first connection at the destination, you can install it before you travel. Data time does not start until it connects there.
- If you are not sure, install close to departure so you do not start the clock by mistake.

See **How to activate eSIM?** after install. The app does not show a separate Activation Policy page.

canDelete.title: Can I delete an eSIM from my phone?
canDelete.body:
Yes, but only when you no longer need it.

You can remove the eSIM when:
- There is no remaining data package
- You will not top it up

## iPhone
- Settings > Cellular
- Tap the eSIM
- Remove / Delete eSIM

## Android
- Settings > Network & internet (or Connections > SIM manager)
- Select the eSIM and delete it

**Important:** once you delete this eSIM, you cannot install the same one again from Etizaz.

iosDevices.title: iOS devices
iosDevices.body:
Your iPhone or iPad must be carrier-unlocked and eSIM-compatible. Country and carrier rules may still apply.

- iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone XR or later

howToKnow.title: How do I know if my phone supports eSIM?
howToKnow.body:
Most phones from 2018 onward can support eSIM, but it depends on the model, country, and whether the phone is carrier-unlocked.

## Check if the phone is unlocked
- Remove the physical SIM
- Insert a SIM from another operator
- If you can make a call, the phone is unlocked

## Does my iPhone support eSIM?
Apple’s first eSIM iPhones were iPhone XS, XS Max, and XR (2018). Later models usually support eSIM, except many China-region iPhones.

- Settings > General > About
- Carrier Lock should say **No SIM restrictions**
- Scroll to Available SIM (iOS 15+) or Digital SIM
- An extra 15-digit IMEI means eSIM hardware is present

If two lines are already active, you may need to turn one off before adding a Etizaz eSIM.

## Does my Android support eSIM?
Android varies by brand. Check the maker, or use the steps below. You can also search Help Center.

## Google Pixel
- Settings > Network & internet
- Tap + beside SIMs
- If you see **Download a SIM instead?**, the phone supports eSIM

## Samsung
- Settings > Connections
- SIM card manager
- If **Add mobile plan** or Add eSIM is available, it supports eSIM

## Huawei and others
- Settings > About phone > show EID, or dial *#06#
- If an **EID** number appears, the device has eSIM hardware

whatIsEsim.title: What is an eSIM?
whatIsEsim.body:
An **eSIM (embedded SIM)** is a digital SIM. You activate a data plan without a plastic card. In Etizaz you buy a plan, then install it from a QR code, activation code, or **Install on this device**.

## Benefits
- **Convenience:** switch plans without swapping a card
- **Travel:** stay online abroad on a local or regional plan
- **No physical SIM:** nothing to lose or replace

## How to use a Etizaz eSIM
- Buy a plan for your destination
- Install it from **Installation**
- Follow **How to activate eSIM?** so data roaming (and APN if needed) are on

eSIMs only work on compatible, network-unlocked devices.

physicalSim.title: Can I still use my physical SIM card?
physicalSim.body:
Yes. Compatible iPhones and Androids can use Dual SIM: your physical SIM for calls and your Etizaz eSIM for data (or the other way around).

Choose which line is used for mobile data in Cellular / SIM settings.

remainingData.title: I have remaining data on my eSIM. Can I use it later?
remainingData.body:
Each Etizaz eSIM has a data amount and a validity period.

You can use remaining data only while the validity period is still running. Unused data does not pause if you turn the line off, and it expires when the period ends.

whenTopup.title: When can I top up an eSIM?
whenTopup.body:
The eSIM must still be **installed** on the phone. Check Cellular / SIM settings. If it is still there, open **My eSIMs**, open the order, and tap **Top up** if that order allows it.

## Important
Once the eSIM is **deleted** from the phone, it **cannot be installed again or topped up**.

howFarAdvance.title: How far in advance of my trip should I buy an eSIM?
howFarAdvance.body:
You can buy a Etizaz eSIM whenever you like. When to **install** it depends on when validity starts.

- If validity starts when the eSIM first connects at the destination, install it before you leave (for example the day before). It should stay inactive until you arrive.
- If you are not sure, install just before you travel.

**If the plan starts at install, the validity period can run even before you arrive.**

reinstallOtherDevice.title: Can I reinstall an eSIM on another device?
reinstallOtherDevice.body:
No. A Etizaz eSIM cannot be reinstalled on the same phone or moved to another phone after you delete it. Do **not** remove an eSIM you still want to use.

To pause data, **turn the line off** instead of deleting it. Validity does **not** pause while it is off. Turning it off can still reduce background data use.

## Turn off on iPhone
- Settings > Cellular > SIMs
- Select the eSIM
- Turn **This Line** off

## Turn off on Android
- Settings > Network & internet > SIMs (or Connections > SIM manager)
- Select the eSIM
- Turn the eSIM off

noData.title: Why can't I access data with my eSIM?
noData.body:
## Is the eSIM installed?
You should see it in Settings > Cellular (iPhone) or Settings > Network & internet (Android). If not, follow Installation in the app.

## Is data roaming on?
Open the eSIM in those same settings and turn Data Roaming on. Also see **How to activate eSIM?** and the roaming articles.

## Are you in coverage?
You must be in the country or region of the plan. Try Airplane Mode on then off, or restart the phone.

unableActivateIos.title: Unable to activate eSIM (iOS)
unableActivateIos.body:
An iPhone may stay on “Activating” or show “Activation failure” if you installed the eSIM before you reached the destination.

The eSIM can still be fully installed. Activation often finishes when you arrive and the phone can see a supported network. Keep Data Roaming on and wait until you have coverage.

slowSpeeds.title: I am experiencing slow network speeds
slowSpeeds.body:
Speed depends on coverage, congestion, and the local operator. Try this:
- In Cellular / Mobile settings for the eSIM, temporarily set Voice & Data (iPhone) or Preferred network type (Android) to **3G** or LTE only
- Turn Airplane Mode on for 30 seconds, then off
- Manually select another supported network if one is listed

roamingIos.title: Roaming on iOS
roamingIos.body:
Most Etizaz eSIMs need **Data Roaming** on.

- Open **Settings** > **Cellular**
- Tap the installed eSIM
- Turn **Data Roaming** on

roamingAndroid.title: Roaming on Android
roamingAndroid.body:
Most Etizaz eSIMs need **Data roaming** on.

- Open **Settings** > **Connections** or **Network & internet**
- Select the installed eSIM
- Turn **Data roaming** on

codeNoLongerValid.title: “This code is no longer valid” error
codeNoLongerValid.body:
This appears if the eSIM was already added, or the QR code was scanned with a poor connection.

To see if it is already installed:
- iPhone: Settings > General > About — look for the ICCID (it should match My eSIMs)
- The line must be turned on to show ICCID

**If you already deleted this eSIM, you cannot install it again.**

If this is the first install, try:
- Turn off any VPN
- Use a stable Wi-Fi connection
- Remove unused eSIMs if the phone is at its limit
- Update iOS or Android
- Use another method on the Installation screen (QR, Manual, or Install on this device)

iosChecklist.title: iOS troubleshooting checklist
iosChecklist.body:
- **ICCID:** Settings > General > About — should match the ICCID in My eSIMs
- **APN:** Settings > Cellular > your eSIM > Cellular Data Network — enter the APN from **How to activate eSIM?** if one is shown
- **Data Roaming:** usually ON
- **Other plans:** turn off other data lines if they steal traffic
- **Cellular Data:** select the Etizaz eSIM
- **Network Selection:** pick a network manually if automatic fails
- **Limit IP Address Tracking:** off
- **Voice & Data:** try LTE / 4G

pixelChecklist.title: Pixel troubleshooting checklist
pixelChecklist.body:
- **ICCID:** Phone app > dial *#06# > Call — find ICCID
- **APN:** Settings > Network & internet > SIMs > your eSIM > Access point names
- **Data roaming:** usually ON
- **Mobile data:** the purchased eSIM must be selected
- **Network:** pick a supported operator manually if needed
- **Preferred network type:** 4G or LTE

samsungChecklist.title: Samsung troubleshooting checklist
samsungChecklist.body:
- **ICCID:** Settings > Connections > SIM manager > eSIM > More information — match My eSIMs
- **APN:** Settings > Connections > Mobile networks > Access Point Names > add/save the APN from Activation
- **Data roaming:** usually ON
- **Mobile data:** select the purchased eSIM in SIM manager
- **Network operators:** disable automatic and pick a supported network
- **Network mode:** 4G / LTE

hotspotIos.title: Hotspot for iOS
hotspotIos.body:
To turn on Personal Hotspot:
- **Settings**
- **Personal Hotspot**
- Turn on **Allow Others to Join**

If Activation / your eSIM details show a manual **APN**, set the same APN for the hotspot:
- Settings > Cellular / Mobile Data
- Tap the Etizaz eSIM
- Cellular Data Network
- In **Personal Hotspot APN**, type the APN in lowercase with no spaces
- Leave username and password empty

hotspotAndroid.title: Hotspot for Android
hotspotAndroid.body:
Set the **APN** first if Activation says you need one, then enable the hotspot.

- Open **Settings**
- **Network & internet** (or Connections)
- **Hotspot & tethering**
- Turn on **Wi-Fi hotspot**
